name: How does interior wear-and-tear repair usually work?
description: It usually involves inspecting the damage, choosing the right repair method, matching the finish, and blending the repaired area into the surrounding surface.

mainEntity.name: How does interior wear-and-tear repair usually work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with an inspection or photos, followed by a repair plan, material matching, and the actual restoration work. For interior surfaces, a good repair often depends on matching color, texture, grain, and sheen so the result does not stand out after the fix.
